Today’s motivation“Disciplined today. Free tomorrow.”

Weekly Habits

How Weekly Habits Work Each habit’s weekly goal is also the number of pulls available for that habit. For example, a goal of 4 times per week gives that habit 4 pulls. Each time you complete the habit, click Earn the Pull to use 1 of those pulls. The total number of Weekly Habit Pulls determines how many Lucky Pulls are needed for each Reward Tier. In Settings, you can add or remove habits and change each habit’s name, times per week, and color.

Today's Tasks

How Today's Tasks Work Add the tasks you want to complete today. Finish the locked tasks to earn Bonus Pulls: 1–4 tasks = 1 pull, 5–8 tasks = 2 pulls, and 9+ tasks = 3 pulls. Checking your first task locks the tasks that count toward today’s Bonus Pulls. Tasks added or moved here afterward do not count. Unfinished tasks carry over to the next day. Completed tasks are removed the next day. Click the calendar to set an optional due date and time. Click the three-line button to delete a task. Click and drag the three-line button to reorder a task or move it between Today’s Tasks and Tasks for Later. In Settings, turn on Order tasks by due date to place tasks due soonest first automatically. Leave it off to arrange them yourself.

Finish your list to earn Bonus Pulls.

Tasks for Later

How Tasks for Later Works Add tasks you want to remember for later. Tasks here do not earn pulls. Tasks stay here until you move or delete them. Click the calendar to set an optional due date and time. Click the three-line button to delete a task. Click and drag the three-line button to reorder a task or move it between Today’s Tasks and Tasks for Later. In Settings, turn on Order tasks by due date to place tasks due soonest first automatically. Leave it off to arrange them yourself.

Weekly Pulls

How Weekly Pulls Work This box tracks all pulls for the week. Empty circles are pulls you can still earn; filled circles are pulls you have already used. Each pull is either Lucky or Next Time. Lucky Pulls count toward your Reward Tier. Hover over a filled circle and click × to undo an accidental pull.

        BLOOM BY BIT

        A little corner from me to you.

        Thank you for wandering in. This is where I share a little more about why Bloom by Bit exists, how you can support it, and where you can leave thoughts for what should grow next.

        A little note from me ✦

        I have always been a little particular about the things I use every day. I found habit trackers I loved pieces of, study tools with features I wished others had, and beautiful productivity spaces that were almost what I was looking for.

        So I decided to make my own little corner of the internet.

        Bloom by Bit is my attempt to bring all those little things together. Something practical enough to keep me on track, whimsical enough to make me want to come back, and filled with the tiny details I kept wishing existed elsewhere.

        It is built around a simple idea: you do not have to change everything at once. Just keep growing, bit by bit. ✧

        If Bloom by Bit happens to make your days a little more organized, motivating, or magical too, then I am very glad you wandered in.

        Thank you for being here. 🌱

        Buy me a coffee ☕

        If Bloom by Bit has made your day a bit easier, helped you stay on track, or simply made studying feel a little prettier, you can leave a small tip here.

        Completely optional, always appreciated, and a little way to help support Bloom by Bit. ✦

        Have a thought? ✧

        Do you like it? Is there something that feels a little off? Have an idea you wish it could do? I would genuinely love to hear what is working, what could be better, or what little feature you would love to see appear next.

        How the Study Timer Works Pomodoro: alternates focus sessions with short breaks. After your chosen number of focus sessions, you get a long break. Regular Focus Timer: runs one focus countdown with no break cycle. Choose Pomodoro or Regular Focus mode, set your times, and choose automatic or manual Pomodoro transitions in Settings. Use Start to begin or pause, Reset to restart the current interval, and Skip to move to the next Pomodoro interval.
